title: The desktop app installs updates on quit without a dialog, enforces the minimum version from the signed feed, and announces what's new in Help & about
expect: S1: a version below minimumVersion is blocked (or warn before minimumVersionAfter); only a higher policyRevision replaces the stored policy; start decides from policy.json at once and waits at most 1.5 s for the feed; warn turns into blocked by its own timer at the deadline; a downloaded version on a Mac asks nothing and counts as staged only when Squirrel says so; Windows keeps its Restart question; a reminder comes after three days, at most one a day; no update question ever opens without a parent window; the blocked gate turns every way of opening a window into the blocked screen; a higher minor than the last run is pending news until seen.
S2: Help & about shows the running version's notes with Full changelog, the ready-to-install notes above them, no Later, the install line by installMode, and marks What's new seen once shown.
fence: the policy is read only from a channel file whose Ed25519 signature verified under the pinned key; the blocked screen's IPC answers only its own local page

tests: below the minimum before its date: warn with the deadline; at the date: blocked
acceptPolicy takes only a higher revision than the stored one
start: the stored policy decides at once, before the network answers
warn turns into blocked at the deadline, by its own timer, without a poll
a downloaded update asks nothing on a Mac: no dialog, nothing installs until quit or Restart
install on quit: Mac (Squirrel) and AppImage yes; Windows NSIS keeps the Restart question; a copy that cannot replace itself never
a version ready for three days brings one reminder, then one a day — never two in a day
with no window there is never a dialog: a notification, and the quiet answer
blocked: the blocked screen opens and the product windows close; every way in shows the blocked screen
seen() clears it for good: the next start does not announce it again
